# GIMP GUI Interface Description

## System and Window Information

- **Application Name**: GNU Image Manipulation Program (GIMP)
- **Window Title**: `[road_watermarked] (imported)-1.0 (RGB color 8-bit gamma integer, GIMP built-in sRGB, 1 layer) 1250x833 – GIMP`
- **System Tray Information**: 
  - Date and Time: `Oct 23 16:34`
  - System Notification Bell Icon
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons in top-right corner
- **Desktop Environment**: Activities panel visible on left side, indicating GNOME desktop

## Top Menu Bar

- **Menu Items** (from left to right):
  - File
  - Edit
  - Select
  - View
  - Image
  - Layer
  - Colors

  - Filters
  - Windows

## Left Sidebar (Toolbox and Tool Options)

### Tool Icons (Top to Bottom)

- **Move Tool** (four-way arrow)
- **Rectangle Select Tool** (rectangle with dotted outline)
- **Ellipse Select Tool** (ellipse with dotted outline)
- **Fuzzy Select Tool** (magic wand)
- **Scissors Tool** (scissors icon)
- **Free Select Tool** (freehand selection)
- **Path Tool** (pen icon)
- **Text Tool** (letter "A")
- **Brush Tool** (paintbrush)

- **Airbrush Tool** (airbrush)

- **Clone Tool** (clone stamp)
- **Healing Tool** (healing brush)
- **Blur Tool** (blur)
- **Smudge Tool** (smudge)
- **Bucket Fill Tool** (paint bucket)
- **Gradient Tool** (gradient)
- **Pattern Fill Tool** (pattern)
- **Color Picker Tool** (eyedropper)
- **Zoom Tool** (magnifying glass)
- **Hand Tool** (hand)

### Tool Options Panel (Below Tool Icons)

- **Tool Group**: Crop
- **Options**:
  - `Current layer only` (unchecked)
  - `Delete cropped pixels` (unchecked)
  - `Allow growing` (unchecked)
  - `Expand from center` (unchecked)
  - `Fixed` (selected)
  - `Aspect ratio` (dropdown menu)
  - `1250:83` (aspect ratio input with reset icon)
  - `Position` (X: 0, Y: 0, units: px)
  - `Size` (Width: 0, Height: 0, units: px)
  - `Highlight` (opacity: 50.0)
  - `No guides` (dropdown menu)
  - `Auto Shrink` (button)
  - `Shrink merged` (unchecked)

## Main Canvas Area

- **Image Display**:
  - Image content: A desert road with red rock formations on either side, under an orange sky.
  - Road has double yellow lines down the center.
  - Watermark: `© PhotoMarks` in the bottom right corner.
  - Image is surrounded by a yellow dashed selection border.
- **Canvas Grid**:
  - Vertical and horizontal rulers visible on left and top edges.
  - Ruler units in pixels.
  - Grid lines visible at 250, 500, 750, 1000, 1250, 1500 pixel marks.
- **Status Bar**:
  - Zoom level: `66.7%`
  - File name: `road_watermarked.jpg (9.7 MB)`

## Right Sidebar (Layers and Brushes Panel)

### Brushes Panel

- **Brush Selection**:
  - `2. Hardness 050 (51 x 51)` (selected brush)
  - Brush preview: Various brush shapes including stars, circles, and textured patterns.
  - `Basic,` (brush category)
  - `Spacing` (set to 10.0)
- **Brush Options**:
  - Brush size adjustment
  - Brush hardness adjustment
  - Brush spacing adjustment
  - Brush rotation adjustment
  - Brush opacity adjustment

### Layers Panel

- **Layer Display**:
  - One visible layer named `road_watermark`
  - Layer thumbnail: A small preview of the image
  - Layer visibility icon (eye icon) is enabled
  - Layer opacity: 100.0%
  - Layer blending mode: `Normal`
  - Layer lock options: None selected

## Bottom Status Bar

- **Zoom Level**: `66.7%`
- **File Name**: `road_watermarked.jpg (9.7 MB)`
